title: The Stars (Are Out Tonight)
original_lyrics:
[verse]
Uh Uh Uh Uh Stars are never sleeping
Uh Uh Uh Uh Dead ones and the living
We live closer to the earth and nearer to the heavens
The stars are never far away and the stars are out tonight
They watch us from behind their shades, Bridgitte, Jack and Kate and Brad
From behind their tinted window stretch, gleaming like blackened sunshine
Uh Uh Uh Uh Stars are never sleeping
Uh Uh Uh Uh Dead ones and the living
Waiting for the first move, satyrs and their child wives
Waiting for the last move, soaking up our primitive world
Uh Uh Uh Uh Stars are never sleeping
Uh Uh Uh Uh Dead ones and the living
Their jealousy´s spilling down, the stars must stick together
We will never be rid of the stars, but I hope they live forever
And they know just what we do, what we toss and turned at night
They´re waiting to make their moves, But the stars are out tonight
Here they are upon the stairs, sexless and unaroused
They are the stars, they´re dying for you

[bridge]
They burn you with their radiant smiles and
Trap you with their beautiful eyes
They´re broke and shamed or drunk or scared

[bridge]
Their jealousy´s spilling down, the stars must stick together
We will never be rid of the stars, but I hope they live forever
And they know just what we do, what we toss and turned at night
They´re waiting to make their moves, But the stars are out tonight Yeah, Yeah
The stars are out tonight
The stars are out tonight
